{"code": "
import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (tapping mode) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print("AFM Scan Parameters Set:")
print(f"Image Size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
print(f"Operating Mode: Dynamic AFM (tapping mode)")

# Start scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the file path of the saved image
# The image is automatically saved by the AFM software
# We need to get the last saved file path
try:
    # Try to get the gallery history path
    gallery_path = application.GetGalleryHistoryPath()
    print(f"\nImage saved at: {gallery_path}")
    image_path = gallery_path
except:
    # If that doesn't work, check the default save location
    print("\nAttempting to find saved image...")
    image_path = "Image saved in AFM gallery"

del spm
print(f"\nFinal image path: {image_path}")
"}

import nanosurf
import time

try:
    # Load application
    spm = nanosurf.SPM()
    application = spm.application
    
    # Get all necessary objects
    scan = application.Scan
    opmode = application.OperatingMode
    
    # Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (tapping mode) to minimize tip damage
    opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM
    
    # Set scan parameters
    scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
    scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
    scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines)
    scan.Points = 128  # points per line
    scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
    
    print("AFM Scan Parameters Set:")
    print(f"Image Size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
    print(f"Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
    print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
    print(f"Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
    print(f"Operating Mode: Dynamic AFM")
    
    # Start scan
    print("\nStarting scan...")
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    
    # Wait for scan to complete
    scanning = scan.IsScanning
    while scanning:
        remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
        print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
        time.sleep(3)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
    
    print("Scanning finished!")
    
    # Get the file path
    gallery_path = application.GetGalleryHistoryPath()
    print(f"\nImage saved at: {gallery_path}")
    
    del spm
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
"}

    scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6
    scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6
    scan.Scantime = 0.4
    scan.Points = 128
    scan.Lines = 128

    print(f"Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
    print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
    
    # Start scan

    print("\nScan started...")
